source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Click tab "Dashboard"
And also enter "Server Health" -> "Sensor Reading"

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor Reading & Threshold is human reable and match with spec.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES submits the INLET1~2 shorthand as one literal record and cannot prove two readings. It does not identify the two physical intake locations, distinguish local baseboard inlet from rack/chassis ambient, define airflow/reference conditions, or collect complete threshold/UI/freshness evidence.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED correctly requires two separate records, location mapping and recorded airflow, but V3.1 further requires the measurement plane and recirculation/rack-ambient relationship so an inlet reading is not accepted against an unrelated ambient limit.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 887/2291 accepts the literal range operand and output presence without two physical intake paths, measurement planes, airflow/reference context, threshold completeness or UI freshness correlation.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: Wistron-BMC-00072-V003 separately requests dynamic threshold/assert-deassert behavior for TEMP_GB_INLET1~2, and Wistron-BMC-00971-V002 separately covers IB/OOB sensor-list and WebUI parity. Those purposes do not authorize airflow obstruction or heating here.

historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 preserves the source label; ED-34 treats physical inlet map, measurement plane, limits and Script as readiness; ED-35 keeps this display check passive without fan/load/airflow stimulus; ED-38 requires protected complete evidence, no clear/write/retry and engineer-owned verdict.

original_test_intent: Verify `TEMP_GB_INLET1` and `TEMP_GB_INLET2` are the two intended GPU-baseboard inlet-air temperature records and are individually readable in Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading with correct intake-location identity, value, units, status and supported thresholds for the Project cooling specification.
original_method: Confirm GB and INLET terminology, map each index to its physical intake path and measurement plane, resolve two stable BMC records, and compare complete passive raw/UI fields with location-specific limits under recorded rack ambient, system load, fan speed and airflow conditions. Preserve logs and the cooling configuration.
manual_activity: The platform/thermal owner identifies the two intake locations and measurement planes, defines their relation to rack ambient and recirculation, and supplies location-specific limits. Automation can collect both BMC records and UI views; a human records the physical cooling context and owns the verdict. No fan, load, baffle, cable or airflow manipulation is authorized.
required_inputs: Chassis and GPU-baseboard PN/revision, BMC/BIOS build and confirmed GB/INLET terminology
Physical INLET1/INLET2 locations, intake paths, measurement planes and sensor placement/part map
Definition of rack ambient versus chassis or GPU-baseboard local inlet plus allowed recirculation/gradient
BMC telemetry source for both readings, including sensor device, controller, bus, mux, address and exact field
Stable SDR and Dashboard/Server Health identities for each inlet
Per-location units, scaling, tolerance, thresholds/hysteresis, status, polling interval and stale/unavailable rules
Rack ambient/reference temperature method and timestamp plus system power/load, fan speeds, airflow direction, baffle/cable and cooling state
Validated protected ipmitool/API/browser access and pinned reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or manual method
safety_requirements: Do not clear SEL, kernel, GPU, fan or thermal logs; existing airflow/thermal evidence must remain available.
Do not issue `sensor get 'TEMP_GB_INLET1~2'` unless documented as one record. Enumerate and query both exact sensor identities separately.
Do not assume both sensors share one threshold or that rack ambient equals a downstream baseboard inlet; compare each with the approved measurement-plane specification.
Do not block vents, move baffles/cables, change rack doors, fan policy/speed, workload, thresholds or hardware. Record the existing cooling condition without creating a temperature excursion.
Any reference thermometer must use an approved non-obstructive placement and synchronized sampling; it must not disturb the intake or require live chassis service.

Do not truncate inventory, expose passwords with `-P`, assume cipher 17 or execute the inaccessible Script. Stop without automatic retry on missing/duplicate/swapped sensors, stale readings or raw/UI/reference disagreement.
agent_execution_scope: Validate the target and two-inlet physical/measurement-plane map, BMC source, client and Script; establish a two-row expectation matrix before collection.
Read INLET1 and INLET2 independently with full SDR identity, value, units, supported thresholds, status and timestamp; capture both unchanged Dashboard and Server Health rows.
Record synchronized rack ambient if approved, power/load, fan speeds, airflow direction and cooling configuration; calculate only the Project-approved location-specific comparison or gradient.
Preserve raw/redacted evidence and logs; perform no clear, thermal/load stimulus, fan/airflow/configuration/threshold change, hardware service, automatic retry or DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Confirm GB/INLET semantics and approve the two intake locations, measurement planes and BMC-source mapping.
Define location-specific thermal limits, reference/gradient/tolerance, status and freshness rules, and approve the collection tool/Script and any reference sensor.
Review INLET1 and INLET2 independently and issue the formal verdict without substituting rack ambient, another board inlet or one sensor for the other.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Unfit as written because tilde shorthand is not an IPMI wildcard and a single response cannot prove two inlet sensors. It omits intake-path and measurement-plane mapping, airflow/reference context and UI/spec correlation, truncates fallback data, exposes credentials and assumes cipher support.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Enumerate complete sensors, confirm both physical intake identities and BMC telemetry sources, query each vendor-supported record via protected read-only access, and correlate two UI rows with synchronized cooling-context evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: TEMP_GB_INLET1~2, Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading, readability/specification Criteria, generic clear text, Script URL, DeepSeek commands and 1/0-minute estimates remain preserved; Review expands the range without editing Master or manipulating cooling.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a two-row matrix keyed by physical intake path and measurement plane, stable BMC sensor and telemetry source, then compare complete raw/API and UI fields with per-location limits under synchronized recorded ambient, load, fan and airflow conditions.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact chassis/GPU-baseboard airflow topology and BMC/SDR/WebUI build documented by the Project.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis/GPU-baseboard, BIOS/BMC/SDR/WebUI, management client and Script revisions plus thermal/reference instrument identity if used.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Chassis and GPU-baseboard mechanical/airflow diagram, sensor placement and BMC sensor definition, thermal design/specification, WebUI schema and Project configuration recipe.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Resolves a range into two physical intake-bound records and adds measurement-plane, ambient/recirculation and synchronized cooling-context evidence while preserving passive display coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Static inlet readings do not validate fan-control response, air-volume/pressure, workload thermal margin, threshold events or shutdown protection; those require separate approved tests.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Two-inlet physical/BMC map, measurement-plane acceptance, passive-state timing, protected tool or reviewed Script and evidence contract.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Local inlet temperature can differ from rack ambient because of recirculation, upstream heat and sensor placement; UI polling lag can create false disagreement.

project_override_considerations: A Project may use Redfish/OEM telemetry or an approved reference sensor as an alternative/corroboration only while preserving the original ipmitool method, recording interface/version/field or exact reference location and reason, obtaining engineer approval and proving equivalent separate INLET1/INLET2 identity, value, threshold, status and freshness coverage.
expected_evidence: Chassis/GPU-baseboard PN/revision, BMC/BIOS, confirmed terminology and two-row physical intake path, measurement-plane, sensor-placement and BMC-source map
Complete separate raw INLET1/INLET2 records with stable IDs, values, units, threshold capabilities/values, status and synchronized timestamps plus redacted Dashboard/Server Health rows

Project thermal limits and recorded rack ambient/reference method, power/load, fan speeds, airflow direction, baffle/cable and cooling configuration with per-location tolerance/gradient and UI update-lag evaluation

Explicit missing/duplicate/swapped/stale/divergent disposition, pinned Script/tool security evidence, no-clear/no-load/no-fan-or-airflow-change/no-retry proof, final BMC/cooling health and engineer-owned two-sensor verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The range is unsuitable as one command and inlet locations are underdefined, but Items, UI Procedure and Criteria consistently request passive display/specification validation of two inlet temperatures. Physical and environmental context is a readiness input, not a conflicting purpose.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The two-sensor inlet-temperature purpose is clear. Project SPEC and thermal documentation can supply the locations, measurement planes and acceptance conditions, so their absence at review time is not a permanent blocker.

review_improvement: Prevents a failed range query or one ambient-like value from being presented as two GPU-baseboard intake sensors, and prevents fan/load/airflow changes from being inserted into a passive Sensor Page check.
independent_technical_reasoning: Inlet temperature is meaningful only at a defined physical plane. Two nearby sensors can legitimately differ because of recirculation, cable/baffle geometry or upstream heat, so equality or a generic ambient limit is not a sound criterion. Identity, synchronized context and location-specific tolerances are required, while this passive row provides no authority to manipulate cooling.
